::api-operation{method="GET" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/comments"}
#docs
With exactly `resource_type` + `resource_id`: every comment on that record, oldest first, unpaged (`has_more` false). Omit both — or add `limit`, `starting_after`, `sort_by[asc|desc]=created_at` or `created_at[op]` — for the cursor-paginated list, business-wide or scoped by either param. Oldest first unless `sort_by[desc]=created_at`.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |

## Query parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `resource_type` | `string` | no | Only comments on this kind of resource. |
| `resource_id` | `string` | no | Public id of the resource_type record |
| `limit` | `integer` | no | Maximum number of comments to return. |
| `starting_after` | `string` | no | Opaque cursor from a previous `next_cursor`. |
| `sort_by[desc]` | `string` | no | Sort by this field, newest first. |
| `created_at[after]` | `string` | no | Any date operator: created_at[before\|after\|on\|between\|…] |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `list`. One of `list`. |
| `data` | `array of object` | The comments. |
| `has_more` | `boolean` | Always false on the per-record list |
| `next_cursor` | `string` | Pass as `starting_after` to get the next page. Null on the last page. |
| `total` | `integer` | Total number of comments. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | Success |
| `400` | Invalid resource_type, one of resource_type/resource_id without the other on the per-record list, or an invalid list param |
